feeds.title: PhotoBook Journal
feeds.description: PhotoBook Journal is written and edited by Douglas Stockdale, Gerhard Clausing, and Melanie Chapman and provides photographic book reviews and occasionally some photographic book publishing news.

feeds.title: Collector Daily » Photobooks
feeds.description: Collector Daily is a venue for thoughtful discussion of vintage and contemporary fine art photography. We review recent museum exhibitions, gallery shows, photography auctions, photobooks, art fairs and other items of interest to photography collectors large and small.

feeds.title: Zookbinders Blog
feeds.description: Zookbinders Inc is a high-quality manufacturer of custom photo albums serving professional photographers. Since our inception in 1995, we've consistently been a leader in our industry through our focus on innovation and creativity. Check out all the latest blog articles from Zookbinders to learn more about photographer's tips, updated company news and Zookbinders culture.

feeds.title: Snapfish US Blog
feeds.description: 'The Current' is the official Snapfish US blog, a place to find fresh and easy inspiration for the photographers and creators in us all. Check it out now!

feeds.title: Elizabeth Avedon
feeds.description: Hi, I am Elizabeth Avedon. Here you will find articles on Photographs, Books, Art, Vintage & Contemporary.

feeds.title: 10×10 Photobooks
feeds.description: 10x10 Photobooks is a non-profit organization with the mission to foster engagement with the global photobook community through an appreciation, dissemination and understanding of photobooks. Founded in 2012, 10x10 offers an ongoing multi-platform series of public photobook events, including reading rooms, salons, publications, and partnerships with art organizations and institutions.

feeds.title: ZoomIn blog
feeds.description: ZoomIn, India's #1 online photo service, is about connecting people and their moments of magic.

feeds.title: Photo-eye
feeds.description: The photo-eye Blog, found at blog.photoeye.com, is a rich resource for photography enthusiasts, featuring photobook reviews, artist interviews, and the latest news from the photo-eye Bookstore and Gallery. Established by photo-eye, a prominent photography bookseller and gallery, the blog serves as a platform for in-depth discussions about contemporary photography. The editorial team, led by photo-eye's knowledgeable staff, includes contributions from various photographers and writers who provide insights and reviews, making it an essential read for those interested in the photographic arts.

feeds.title: My Canvas
feeds.description: MyCanvas has offered customized photobooks, calendars, and collage posters since 2007 when it was first established by Ancestry.com. Alexander's partnered with Ancestry.com to print MyCanvas products since its inception and continues to print them today.

feeds.title: Book This Project Blog
feeds.description: Book This Project shows you how you can organize and print your photos with success and without overwhelm. I'm Stacey Wiseman and I help photographers - hobbyists and professionals - print their photos.

feeds.title: The Independent Photobook
feeds.description: The Independent Photo Book announces independently published and/or produced photography books or zines, which are not available via Amazon or other standard outlets.

feeds.title: The Angry Bat's
feeds.description: The Angry Bat's nice photobooks site focuses on the presentation of photography books. We will try to present one book each week. The Angry Bat is a publishing trademark created by the Slovene fine art photographer Matej Sitar.

feeds.title: Photobookstore Magazine
feeds.description: Online Photobook emporium featuring some of the best photobooks from around the world, along with signed, rare and out of print titles.

feeds.title: Photo Book Girl Blog
feeds.description: This site is about sharing ideas and tips on photo book making and navigating through the ever increasing number of photo book companies out there, each with their own software and spin on the process. I will be reviewing printers that I've used before, comparing them to new ones, sharing tips for designing better books, as well as posting photo book deals.
